name: System Monitor
description: RAM, swap and load with recent history, and memory used by each session including its child processes

settings.label: Sampling interval (seconds)
settings.description: How often to read memory, swap, load and per-session memory.

settings.label: Warning threshold (%)
settings.description: RAM or swap use at which the monitor warns.

settings.label: Critical threshold (%)
settings.description: RAM or swap use at which the monitor raises a critical alert.

settings.label: Alert when a threshold is crossed
settings.description: Shows a toast in CliDeck even when the monitor tab is closed.
